# ---- Master/Logistics combined grid builder — inline runPrepQuery (Order-spike pattern) ----
	# Executes the canonical Logistics/list SQL from master-crud-namedqueries.sql via
	# system.db.runPrepQuery. IG81-COMPAT: plain parameterized T-SQL; runs identically on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	parts = unicode(value).split("|")
	searchTerm = parts[0]
	siteId = int(float(parts[1]))   # IG-SITE: plumbed through view->query; predicate still commented (D1)

	sql = ("SELECT  IN_LOGISTICS_ID    AS RecordID, "
	       "        VC_LOGISTICS_NAME  AS LogisticsName, "
	       "        VC_CITY            AS City, "
	       "        VC_STATE           AS State, "
	       "        VC_TEL             AS Telephone, "
	       "        VC_PERSON          AS Person "
	       "FROM    INV_LOGISTICS_MST "
	       "WHERE  (? = '' OR VC_LOGISTICS_NAME LIKE '%' + ? + '%' OR VC_PERSON LIKE '%' + ? + '%') "
	       "-- IG-SITE:  AND site_id = ? "
	       "ORDER BY VC_LOGISTICS_NAME")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(sql, [searchTerm, searchTerm, searchTerm], DB)
	log.info("SPIKE Logistics/list: %d rows (search='%s' site=%d)" % (ds.rowCount, searchTerm, siteId))

	columns = [
		{"field": "LogisticsName", "header": {"title": "Logistics Name"}},
		{"field": "City",          "header": {"title": "City"}},
		{"field": "State",         "header": {"title": "State"}, "strictWidth": 90},
		{"field": "Telephone",     "header": {"title": "Telephone"}, "strictWidth": 120},
		{"field": "Person",        "header": {"title": "Person"}},
		{"field": "RecordID",      "header": {"title": "id"}, "visible": False}
	]
	rows = []
	for r in xrange(ds.rowCount):
		rows.append({
			"RecordID":      ds.getValueAt(r, "RecordID"),
			"LogisticsName": ds.getValueAt(r, "LogisticsName"),
			"City":          ds.getValueAt(r, "City"),
			"State":         ds.getValueAt(r, "State"),
			"Telephone":     ds.getValueAt(r, "Telephone"),
			"Person":        ds.getValueAt(r, "Person")
		})
	return {"data": rows, "columns": columns}

onChange.script:
# ---- Logistics combined view: recordId change -> load detail ----
	# The grid onRowClick sets self.view.custom.recordId = event.value["RecordID"] (a
	# same-view prop write, NO navigation). This onChange fires on that write and
	# populates the in-view form. recordId==0 -> insert mode.
	# IG81-COMPAT: plain change script + T-SQL, identical on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	v = self.view if hasattr(self, "view") else self
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = v.custom
	cv = getattr(currentValue, "value", currentValue)
	recId = int(cv or 0)
	log.info("SPIKE Logistics Detail recordId onChange fired: recId=%s origin=%s" % (recId, origin))

	if recId <= 0:
		c.statusMsg = "New logistics — enter details and Save."
		log.info("SPIKE Logistics Detail: insert mode (recordId=0)")
		return

	getSql = ("SELECT IN_LOGISTICS_ID, VC_LOGISTICS_NAME, VC_ADDRESS, VC_CITY, VC_STATE, VC_ZIP, "
	          "VC_COUNTRY, VC_TEL, VC_FAX, VC_PERSON, VC_EMAIL_ADDRESS, VC_BREAKDOWN_ORDER_DIRECTORY "
	          "FROM INV_LOGISTICS_MST WHERE IN_LOGISTICS_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(getSql, [recId], DB)
	if ds.rowCount == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Logistics id %d not found." % recId
		log.warn("SPIKE Logistics Detail: id %d not found" % recId); return
	def g(col):
		val = ds.getValueAt(0, col)
		return val if val is not None else ""
	c.form_name = g("VC_LOGISTICS_NAME"); c.form_address = g("VC_ADDRESS")
	c.form_city = g("VC_CITY"); c.form_state = g("VC_STATE"); c.form_zip = g("VC_ZIP")
	c.form_country = g("VC_COUNTRY"); c.form_tel = g("VC_TEL"); c.form_fax = g("VC_FAX")
	c.form_person = g("VC_PERSON"); c.form_email = g("VC_EMAIL_ADDRESS")
	c.form_directory = g("VC_BREAKDOWN_ORDER_DIRECTORY")
	c.statusMsg = "Editing logistics %s (id %d)." % (c.form_name, recId)
	log.info("SPIKE Logistics Detail loaded id=%d name=%s" % (recId, c.form_name))

config.script:
# Re-run Logistics/list. Bumping runNonce changes the gridModel expression input.
	self.view.custom.runNonce = (self.view.custom.runNonce or 0) + 1
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("Logistics search -> runNonce=" + str(self.view.custom.runNonce))

# Row select -> SAME-VIEW prop write (single-view decision; NO navigation).
	# event.value is the row data in IA 8.1. Set custom.recordId, which fires the
	# custom.recordId onChange load script (D2: RecordID is IN_LOGISTICS_ID, never the name).
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	try:
		recId = event.value["RecordID"]
	except Exception:
		recId = event.value["RecordID"] if hasattr(event, "value") else None
	if recId is None:
		log.warn("SPIKE Logistics list row click: no RecordID in event")
		return
	log.info("SPIKE Logistics list -> open Detail recordId=%s" % recId)
	self.view.custom.recordId = int(recId)

props.text: Click a row to edit in the panel at right. Server-side LIKE search on name+person. Single combined view — row-select is an in-view prop write, no navigation. Site param plumbed; IG-SITE predicate commented until the Postgres phase.

config.script:
# ---- Logistics Save (insert-or-update) ----
	# recordId==0 -> insert; >0 -> update. On success: flip recordId to the saved id
	# (edit mode) and refresh the grid by bumping runNonce (same-view, no navigation).
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	# ---- SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (M4 P15 sweep — the H3 hole-closer) ----
	# auth.requireWrite resolves the caller's roles FROM THE SESSION (gateway-side, NOT a client
	# prop) and authorizes ProductionControl|Admin, raising AuthError on deny — BEFORE any
	# system.db write. A forged client prop or an anonymous session is rejected HERE, not by the
	# UI. This closes the reintroduced legacy H3 hole (the write was previously authorized client-
	# side only). Same gate the Sites Save/Delete/New carry (gen_sites_view.py rule #1).
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)
	except A.AuthError, e:
		c.statusMsg = "DENIED (server-side): " + unicode(e)
		system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").warn("SPIKE Logistics Save DENIED (server-side gate): " + unicode(e)); return
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	siteId = int(c.siteId or 1)   # IG-SITE: plumbed; predicate commented (D1)

	name = (c.form_name or "").strip()

	# ---- validation (client-side fast-fail; DB unique index is the backstop) ----
	# Logistics is keyed by a NAME (no fixed-length code rule). Presence + per-site
	# uniqueness on VC_LOGISTICS_NAME (checkCodeUnique). excludeId supports rename (D2).
	if name == "":
		c.statusMsg = "Logistics name is required."
		log.info("SPIKE Logistics save REJECTED: blank name"); return

	address = (c.form_address or "").strip()
	city = (c.form_city or "").strip()
	state = (c.form_state or "").strip()
	zipc = (c.form_zip or "").strip()
	country = (c.form_country or "").strip()
	tel = (c.form_tel or "").strip()
	fax = (c.form_fax or "").strip()
	person = (c.form_person or "").strip()
	email = (c.form_email or "").strip()
	directory = (c.form_directory or "").strip()

	excludeId = recId if recId > 0 else 0
	chkSql = ("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM INV_LOGISTICS_MST "
	          "WHERE VC_LOGISTICS_NAME = ? AND IN_LOGISTICS_ID <> ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
	dup = system.db.runPrepQuery(chkSql, [name, excludeId], DB)
	if dup.rowCount > 0 and int(dup.getValueAt(0, 0)) > 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Logistics name already exists."
		log.info("SPIKE Logistics save REJECTED: dup name=%s" % name); return

	audit = ("CONVERT(char(8),GETDATE(),112) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),1,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),4,2) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),7,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),10,2)")

	# WIDENED writes: person at full 50, directory at full 512 (legacy procs truncated
	# to 25/215). Direct NQ writes the full DB width.
	args = [name, address, city, state, zipc, country, tel, fax, person, email, directory]

	try:
		if recId == 0:
			insSql = ("INSERT INTO INV_LOGISTICS_MST (VC_LOGISTICS_NAME, VC_ADDRESS, VC_CITY, VC_STATE, VC_ZIP, "
			          "VC_COUNTRY, VC_TEL, VC_FAX, VC_PERSON, VC_EMAIL_ADDRESS, VC_BREAKDOWN_ORDER_DIRECTORY, VC_ADD) "
			          "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?, " + audit + "); "
			          "SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS int) AS newId")
			rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(insSql, args, DB)
			newId = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
			c.statusMsg = "Inserted logistics %s (id %d)." % (name, newId)
			log.info("SPIKE Logistics INSERT ok: name=%s newId=%d" % (name, newId))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
			c.recordId = newId                    # flip to edit mode -> fires onChange reload
		else:
			# audit column is VC_LASTUPDATE (NO underscore) for Logistics (same as Supplier).
			updSql = ("UPDATE INV_LOGISTICS_MST SET VC_LOGISTICS_NAME=?, VC_ADDRESS=?, VC_CITY=?, VC_STATE=?, "
			          "VC_ZIP=?, VC_COUNTRY=?, VC_TEL=?, VC_FAX=?, VC_PERSON=?, VC_EMAIL_ADDRESS=?, "
			          "VC_BREAKDOWN_ORDER_DIRECTORY=?, VC_LASTUPDATE = " + audit + " "
			          "WHERE IN_LOGISTICS_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
			n = system.db.runPrepUpdate(updSql, args + [recId], DB)
			c.statusMsg = "Updated logistics %s (%d row)." % (name, n)
			log.info("SPIKE Logistics UPDATE ok: id=%d name=%s rows=%d" % (recId, name, n))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
	except Exception, e:
		msg = unicode(e)
		if "IX_INV_LOGISTICS_MST" in msg or "duplicate key" in msg.lower() or "UNIQUE" in msg.upper():
			c.statusMsg = "Logistics name already exists."
			log.info("SPIKE Logistics save: unique-index backstop fired for name=%s" % name)
		else:
			c.statusMsg = "Save failed: %s" % msg
			log.warn("SPIKE Logistics save FAILED: %s" % msg)

# ---- Logistics Delete — D3 RESTRICT gate (R1-critical) ----
	# refCount counts ALL THREE inbound references: INV_SUPPLIER_MST,
	# INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST, INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST_HIST (all by IN_LOGISTICS_ID). The live
	# DELETE_LogisticsCode trigger only nullifies the supplier FK and LEAVES parts/_HIST
	# DANGLING — so RESTRICT on all three prevents the legacy dangle. Block on any
	# non-zero total; NEVER reach the trigger while refs exist.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	# ---- SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (M4 P15 sweep — the H3 hole-closer) ----
	# auth.requireWrite resolves the caller's roles FROM THE SESSION (gateway-side, NOT a client
	# prop) and authorizes ProductionControl|Admin, raising AuthError on deny — BEFORE any
	# system.db write. A forged client prop or an anonymous session is rejected HERE, not by the
	# UI. This closes the reintroduced legacy H3 hole (the write was previously authorized client-
	# side only). Same gate the Sites Save/Delete/New carry (gen_sites_view.py rule #1).
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)
	except A.AuthError, e:
		c.statusMsg = "DENIED (server-side): " + unicode(e)
		system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").warn("SPIKE Logistics Delete DENIED (server-side gate): " + unicode(e)); return
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	name = (c.form_name or "").strip()
	if recId == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Nothing to delete (unsaved new record)."
		return
	refSql = ("SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_SUPPLIER_MST        WHERE IN_LOGISTICS_ID = ?) "
	          "     + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST      WHERE IN_LOGISTICS_ID = ?) "
	          "     + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST_HIST WHERE IN_LOGISTICS_ID = ?) AS n")
	rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(refSql, [recId, recId, recId], DB)
	n = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
	log.info("SPIKE Logistics refCount: id=%d name=%s n=%d" % (recId, name, n))
	if n > 0:
		c.statusMsg = ("Cannot delete logistics %s — still referenced by %d supplier(s)/part(s)/history row(s). "
		               "Reassign or archive those rows first.") % (name, n)
		log.info("SPIKE Logistics DELETE BLOCKED: id=%d name=%s refs=%d" % (recId, name, n)); return
	try:
		delN = system.db.runPrepUpdate("DELETE FROM INV_LOGISTICS_MST WHERE IN_LOGISTICS_ID = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?", [recId], DB)
		log.info("SPIKE Logistics DELETE ok: id=%d name=%s rows=%d" % (recId, name, delN))
		c.statusMsg = "Deleted logistics %s." % name
		c.form_name = ""; c.form_address = ""; c.form_city = ""; c.form_state = ""; c.form_zip = ""
		c.form_country = ""; c.form_tel = ""; c.form_fax = ""; c.form_person = ""; c.form_email = ""; c.form_directory = ""
		c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1   # refresh grid (same-view)
		c.recordId = 0                        # back to insert mode
	except Exception, e:
		c.statusMsg = "Delete failed: %s" % unicode(e)
		log.warn("SPIKE Logistics DELETE FAILED: %s" % unicode(e))

# Clear -> reset to a blank insert-mode form (recordId=0). Same-view, no navigation.
	c = self.view.custom
	c.form_name = ""; c.form_address = ""; c.form_city = ""; c.form_state = ""; c.form_zip = ""
	c.form_country = ""; c.form_tel = ""; c.form_fax = ""; c.form_person = ""; c.form_email = ""; c.form_directory = ""
	c.recordId = 0
	c.statusMsg = "Cleared — ready for a new logistics."
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("SPIKE Logistics form cleared")
